title: A derived Zinbiel algebra without a differential Zinbiel embedding in characteristic different from two and three
author: Pavel Kolesnikov; Farukh Mashurov; Bauyrzhan Sartayev
work: On Pre-Novikov Algebras and Derived Zinbiel Variety

difficulty_reason: The counterexample requires choosing a derivative-stable envelope ideal and a distinguished nonzero element in its contraction, then exhausting the derived ideal using explicit free-algebra normal forms and a rank obstruction.
